name: Crew-13
slot_a_text: SpaceX Crew-13 is the thirteenth crewed operational flight of a Crew Dragon spacecraft to the International Space Station as part of NASA's Commercial Crew Program.
slot_b_text: Low Earth orbit is anywhere from about 160 to 2,000 km up, where a satellite laps the planet roughly every 90 minutes. Everything there is falling; it just keeps missing the ground.
description: SpaceX Crew-13 is the thirteenth crewed operational flight of a Crew Dragon spacecraft to the International Space Station as part of NASA's Commercial Crew Program.
program_description: The Commercial Crew Program (CCP) is a human spaceflight program operated by NASA, in association with American aerospace manufacturers Boeing and SpaceX.
